charts.title: WASP-132 c: orbits around WASP-132
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-132's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-132 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Grieves et al. 2025 (2025A&A...693A.144G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GRIEVES_ET_AL__2025): P 1.01153624 d

charts.title: WASP-132 c: its transit
charts.description: WASP-132 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (38, 65, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 127530399, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 7 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 6-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
